name: Bondeno (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of blue and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Bondeno (a white eagle on blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Bondeno, a comune in Emilia-Romagna; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Bondeno arms — white eagle on blue, crowned, within branches
